notes.title: Patch Notes for Hotfix 1.2.3
notes.content:
Resting Spots: Fixed animals sometimes not coming nicely to a resting spot. This was visible especially at the train yard fireplace when reloading a save.
 Mountain Top Resting Spot: Fix checkpoint loading after you get out of quarry. Fixed bridge collision and also the herd now joins you if you lost them on the other side of the bridge.
 Graphics: Fix game having to high FPS when in menu or tabbed out with VSync enabled.
 Achievements: Fix achievements for tamed animals sometimes not including all animals and thus unlocking too late or not at all.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Hotfix 1.2.1
notes.content:
Birch Forest: Fixed flickering trees when loading directly into the Birch Forest
 Canyon Temple: Fixed a save/load bug that hindered you from walking across the pushable in a canyon temple puzzle
 Traindepot: Optimized bridge model LOD for medium quality
 Fixed small issues in German & Swiss German localization
 Achievements: Achievements unlocked in the demo will no longer be blocked from being unlocked in the main game
 Flowers: Fixed a bug where painting flowers were spawned already and collecting them would not reveal the painting.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Hotfix 1.2.0
notes.content:
Fixed missing snowfall and missing rain

 Glade: Fixed an issue where you could run far away from your herd into the dark forest.

 Collision: Fixed trees missing colliders in the Birch Forest

 Glade: Fixed a floating decoration item

 Mountains: Fixed mountains not having snow on top

 Steam Deck: Lowered graphics settings in exchange for better performance

notes.title: Herdling Updates: Gameplay Trailer, Preview Articles and More
notes.content:
We’re excited to share our latest news and updates with you all: 

[previewyoutube=pfivaREoutQ;full][/previewyoutube]

In case you haven’t seen it on the Steam page yet: There’s a new gameplay trailer available for HERDLING! In it, we reveal that the game will be released in Summer 2025. 

Following the new trailer’s release, there was also a bit of media attention that’s definitely worth a look if you’d like to learn a bit more about the game: 

 “How we got the ‘Herd’ in Herdling”: Okomotive’s Creative Lead Don Schmocker gives insight into some design considerations and processes for our Calicorns. 
 "My Love For Incredibly Sad Games Has Me Very Excited For Herdling": GameSpot’s Mark Delaney tried a preview build of the game and shines a light on the emotional impact he expects Herdling to have. 
 "With 18,000 glowing Steam reviews on their lovely debut game, this indie team's game about leading cute fantasy yaks up a mountain is instantly one to watch": GamesRadar picked up on a recent social media post about our game and urges readers to keep an eye on Herdling. 

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45157851/8b5a6bc918a1b6bd8fc692b6250dd7b9e085cc38.png

In addition to press coverage, we’ve also been a lot more active on our social media recently, thanks to the addition of a Marketing and Communication Manager to our team. 

Make sure to follow us on these platforms if you enjoy seeing the occasional new Herdling screenshots and clips in your feed. Shares and reposts are highly appreciated as well! 

 Okomotive on Bluesky
 Okomotive on Twitter/X
 Okomotive on TikTok
 Okomotive on Instagram

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45157851/b4d0c5c475913316d164dd7dcce5e1a7e42a7f67.png

We’ll close this post with a question to the community: Do you have any questions about the game that you’d like us to dive into? We’re considering posting dev diaries here in the future, what aspect of our game’s development would you be interested in getting insight in? 

Let us know what you’d like to see more of! 

💜Your Okomotive Team 💜

notes.title: New game Herdling
notes.content:
After working for more than two years in the dark, Okomotive is proud and happy to present their brand new IP and upcoming game «HERDLING».

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33976734/f83796f984d94a394296f2ce93285e7acc0e8bec.png

Herdling is a new adventure from Okomotive, creators of the atmospheric and acclaimed FAR games, and Panic, publishers of Firewatch.

Head out on a grand alpine expedition with a herd of loveable beasts, as you ascend a mountain path, encounter eerie dangers and surprising obstacles, and forge your way to the mystery at the summit.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tUEcKBVzhQg
Features:

 Guide, protect, and fall in love with a motley herd of Calicorns
Traverse stunning mountainscapes, fog-wreathed forests, snowy plateaus, and forgotten valleys
Hone your herding skills as you navigate a wide range of challenges, threats, and light environmental puzzles
Feel the rush of the mountain air alongside your herd in exhilarating stampede sequences
An emotional, wordless tale of trust, survival, and companionship during a great crossing through a fallen world

Release date: 2025
Platforms: PC & Consoles
 Visit herdling.game 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3047750/Herdling/
